description: This file defines a CrossOriginResourceSharing struct implementing CORS filter logic for HTTP requests, including methods for handling preflight and actual requests, setting headers, and checking allowed origins and headers.

classes.name: CrossOriginResourceSharing
classes.description: Struct implementing CORS filter with headers, allowed origins, methods, headers, and related configuration.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Main filter function implementing CORS flow based on request headers and origin.

methods.name: doActualRequest
methods.description: Handles actual CORS requests, setting headers accordingly.

methods.name: doPreflightRequest
methods.description: Handles preflight OPTIONS requests, validating headers and setting response headers.

methods.name: setOptionsHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers related to CORS options, including expose headers, allow origin, and credentials.

methods.name: isOriginAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given origin is permitted based on AllowedDomains and AllowedDomainFunc.

methods.name: setAllowOriginHeader
methods.description: Sets the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header if origin is allowed.

methods.name: checkAndSetExposeHeaders
methods.description: Adds expose headers to response if configured.

methods.name: checkAndSetAllowCredentials
methods.description: Adds Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header if cookies are allowed.

methods.name: isValidAccessControlRequestMethod
methods.description: Validates if the request method is in the allowed methods list.

methods.name: isValidAccessControlRequestHeader
methods.description: Validates if a request header is allowed based on AllowedHeaders.
